'''Giuseppe Arcidiacono''' (1927–1998) was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[physicist]], born in [[Acireale]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.macrolibrarsi.it/autori/_giuseppe_arcidiacono.php|title=Giuseppe Arcidiacono|website=Macrolibrarsi|access-date=2016-05-18}}</ref> He earned his degree in physics at the [[University of Catania]] in 1951.<ref name="Chiatti">{{cite web |last1=Licata |first1=Ignazio |last2=Chiatti |first2=Leonardo |last3=Benedetto |first3=Elmo |title=De Sitter Projective Relativity |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ay9XDgAAQBAJ&pg=PA3 |publisher=Springer |access-date=19 November 2022 |language=en |date=13 March 2017}}</ref>

Arcidiacono was mathematician [[Luigi Fantappiè]]'s main disciple.<ref name="Chiatti" /> Together they worked on what they called [[de Sitter invariant special relativity|projective relativity]] at the [[Istituto Nazionale di Alta Matematica]] in [[Rome]].<ref name="Scapini2005">{{cite book|author=Felicita Scapini|title=La logica dell'evoluzione dei viventi: spunti di riflessione : atti del XII Convegno del Gruppo italiano di biologia evoluzionistica, Firenze, 18-21 febbraio 2004|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=8r51deppw0oC&pg=PT71|year=2005|publisher=Firenze University Press|isbn=978-88-8453-369-2|page=71}}</ref> 

In 1958 Arcidiacono won a scholarship to the Istituto H. Poincaré in [[Paris]]. He won the [[mathematics]] prize from the [[Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Rocco Vittorio Macrì|title=La realtà del tempo e la ragnatela di Einstein: I passi falsi di un genio contro la Time Reality|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=4WiWBwAAQBAJ&pg=PA22|date=2015-03-24|publisher=Youcanprint Self-Publishing|isbn=978-88-911-8277-7|page=22}}</ref> From 1969 until his death in 1998 he was Professor of [[Mechanical Engineering]] at the [[University of Perugia]].
